verdict.rationale: Calendly ships a first-party MCP server (with DCR OAuth, no pre-registration needed) that exposes tools like event_types-create_event_type and translates natural-language commands into structured API calls, alongside a dedicated Scheduling API for AI agents to book meetings end-to-end and availability endpoints. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's real-world reliability and a fuller listing of all exposed tools beyond the few named.
